title: Fix: Admin-added questions not appearing in topic/category filters

requirements.text: Fix the backend so that questions added via the `addQuestion` update function are included in the results returned by `getByTopic` and `getByYear` query functions. Currently, admin-added questions are stored separately and are not merged into the main question bank that category/topic filters query against. The backend must unify all questions (both hardcoded and admin-added) into a single source that all query functions (`getQuestions`, `getByTopic`, `getByYear`, and the random quiz set function) draw from.

quotes: Added question not seen in ading catogery
Newly added questions do not appear in their assigned category/topic filter

acceptanceCriteria: A question added via `addQuestion` with topic 'Ilmul Advia' is returned when `getByTopic('Ilmul Advia')` is called.
A question added via `addQuestion` with year 2026 is returned when `getByYear(2026)` is called.
A question added via `addQuestion` appears in the full question list returned by `getQuestions`.
Admin-added questions are included in random quiz sets generated by the backend.
Previously hardcoded questions continue to appear in all filters as before.

requirements.text: Fix the frontend Topic Browser screen (`TopicBrowserScreen.tsx`) and any other screens that filter questions by topic or year to also include questions fetched from the backend (via `getAdminQuestions` or the unified question query), not only the local static `questions.ts` data. The topic/category filter UI must merge backend-stored questions with the local question bank so that admin-added questions are visible in the topic browser and year browser.

quotes: Added question not seen in ading catogery

acceptanceCriteria: When a user browses by topic (e.g., 'Ilmul Advia'), questions added via the Admin Panel appear in that topic's list alongside the static questions.
When a user browses by year, admin-added questions for that year appear in the list.
Starting a quiz from a topic or year group includes admin-added questions for that topic/year.
The UI correctly reflects the total count of questions including admin-added ones.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
All Motoko logic must remain in the single backend/main.mo actor file.
The admin question submission form must remain accessible to all users without role restrictions.
nonGoals: Adding new question fields or changing the question data schema.
Changing authentication or access control logic.
Modifying the quiz interface or results screen.
